items.source: Exception - in case of errors
items.translation: Exception - 在发生错误时

items.source: In an async processing scenario, the handler may be executed in a separate thread while the main thread exits without rendering or invoking the postHandle and afterCompletion callbacks. When concurrent handler execution completes, the request is dispatched back in order to proceed with rendering the model and all methods of this contract are invoked again. For further options and comments see org.springframework.web.context.request.async.AsyncWebRequestInterceptor
items.translation: 在异步处理场景中，处理器可能在单独的线程中执行，而主线程在未渲染或未调用`postHandle`和`afterCompletion`回调的情况下退出。当并发处理器执行完成后，请求将被重新分发以继续渲染模型，并且该合约的所有方法将再次被调用。有关更多选项和说明，请参阅org.springframework.web.context.request.async.AsyncWebRequestInterceptor

items.source:
This interface assumes MVC-style request processing: A handler gets executed,
exposes a set of model objects, then a view gets rendered based on that model.
Alternatively, a handler may also process the request completely, with no
view to be rendered.
items.translation: 该接口假设采用 MVC 风格的请求处理：执行一个处理器，暴露一组模型对象，然后基于该模型渲染视图。或者，处理器也可以完全处理请求，无需渲染任何视图。

items.source:
This interface is deliberately minimalistic to keep the dependencies of
generic request interceptors as minimal as feasible.
items.translation: 该接口刻意保持极简，以使通用请求拦截器的依赖尽可能少。

items.source: Note: Will only be called if this interceptor's preHandle method has successfully completed!
items.translation: 注意：仅当此拦截器的preHandle方法成功完成时才会调用！

items.source:
Allows for preparing context resources (such as a Hibernate Session)
and expose them as request attributes or as thread-local objects.
items.translation: 允许准备上下文资源（例如 Hibernate Session），并将其作为请求属性或线程本地对象暴露。

items.source:
Allows for modifying context resources after successful handler
execution (for example, flushing a Hibernate Session).
items.translation: 允许在成功执行处理器后修改上下文资源（例如刷新 Hibernate 会话）。

items.source: Intercept the execution of a request handler after its successful invocation, right before view rendering (if any).
items.translation: 在成功调用请求处理器之后、视图渲染（如果有）之前拦截其执行。

items.source: Intercept the execution of a request handler before its invocation.
items.translation: 在请求处理器被调用之前拦截其执行。

items.source:
Callback after completion of request processing, that is, after rendering
the view.
items.translation: 请求处理完成后的回调，即在渲染视图之后。

items.source: model - the map of model objects that will be exposed to the view (may be null). Can be used to analyze the exposed model and/or to add further model attributes, if desired.
items.translation: `model` - 将暴露给视图的模型对象映射（可为 `null`）。可用于分析已暴露的模型和/或根据需要添加更多模型属性。

items.source: ex - exception thrown on handler execution, if any
items.translation: ex - 如果在执行处理器时抛出异常，则为该异常
